steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and documented project-management experience. Gather your project records now to streamline your application later.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Certification Training course. Attend sessions on your schedule from anywhere; no travel to Norfolk required. Our active certified practitioners deliver real-world context and exam-aligned content over the full program.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After finishing your 35 contact hours, submit your formal PMI application with your education and experience documentation. Pay the PMI examination fee at that time. PMI reviews applications to confirm you meet all eligibility criteria before you sit for the exam.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—study guides, practice questions, and instructor office hours—to build confidence. Schedule your proctored exam through PMI's testing partner. The PMP exam tests your mastery of the PMBOK Guide and real-world scenario management.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: After certification, earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) over a standard three-year cycle to keep your PMP active. Pursue advanced training, contribute to PMI events, or engage in service work. Renewal keeps your credential current and your skills competitive in your local job market.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI sets four eligibility paths based on education: a secondary diploma (high school or equivalent) requires 60 months of project leadership experience; an associate's degree requires 48 months; a bachelor's degree requires 36 months; and a bachelor's or postgraduate degree from a PMI Global Accreditation Center (GAC)-accredited program requires just 24 months. Every path also requires 35 hours of project management education — our course satisfies this requirement in full.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.
